title: Unearthing the Brilliance of Manos: The Hands of Fate (1966)

commenti.body: There's nothing wrong about enjoying a "bad" movie - especially one that did somewhat interesting things within a limited budget. But there's nothing brilliant or transcendent about *Manos*. It's a cheapo movie that can be very entertaining to some and simply left as that.
Its gotta be a joke post
A year ago I'd totally agree, but with the way this sub has been going I have no clue anymore
I watched Manos not too long ago, and found it not as inept as I thought it would be.  I've been watching garbage movies for years, and I have seen films that are worse, believe it or not.
I totally ageee, its bad, but theres worse
Sure. But did you think it was brilliant or transcendent?

A nice comment but you forget the entire reason behind the movie.  You miss the point of what a movie was back in 1966.  That is the reason why it was made and by whom.  Too many people have forgotten it & just try to make money off of it without even knowing why they're doing it.

Thanks for keeping his dream alive though, much appreciated.
